title: Helicopter facelift: Pittsburgh District replaces control tower hoist
description: The U.S. Army Corps Pittsburgh District is working to replace three hoists and wire ropes within the control tower at the East Branch Clarion River Lake in Wilcox, Pennsylvania. The control tower is original to the dam, which was completed in 1952. East Branch Dam has prevented flood damages estimated to be more than $98 million, equivalent to $456 million in today’s dollars. A contractor used a helicopter to remove the first of three hoists. (U.S. Army Corps of Engineers video by Michel Sauret)
